blocks.note: up means in good spirits
a stand-in takes another's place
G is the standard abbreviation for good

explanation.surface: A cheerful, decent replacement player earns praise for being good and honourable.
explanation.definitionFit: An upstanding person is one of integrity and respectability, a close synonym for honourable.

clue.text: Seafood not cooked at noon following pressure

indicators.note: following means coming after, so what precedes this word is placed after what follows it

blocks.note: P is the physics symbol for pressure
uncooked food is raw
N is a common abbreviation for noon

explanation.surface: Someone complains of seafood served uncooked at midday after being pressed to eat it.
explanation.walkthrough: 'following pressure' places the uncooked word after the pressure letter; the noon letter then sits at its end.
explanation.definitionFit: A prawn is a small edible shellfish, an example of seafood.

indicators.note: partially says only part of the run of words is used, so the letters sit inside them
backed suggests going backwards, so the concealed letters are read from right to left

blocks.note: the letters run across the two words, spanning the comma

explanation.surface: A weapon's code is described as protective and only partly supported.
explanation.walkthrough: Read cODE PROTective backwards to get TORPEDO.
explanation.definitionFit: A torpedo is a self-propelled underwater missile, a kind of weapon.

blocks.note: first meaning: a ginger ... is a hard biscuit
second meaning: a fanatic, as in a fitness fan

explanation.walkthrough: A ginger nut is a common British biscuit, so the short word can stand for a biscuit.
explanation.definitionFit: The word names both a hard ginger biscuit and an obsessive fan of something.

clue.text: Additional payment maybe in currency unit one has

blocks.note: taken as written
a cent is a unit of many currencies
Roman numeral one
the contraction 've as in I've stands for has/have

explanation.surface: A bonus might be paid in some currency that a person holds.
explanation.walkthrough: 'one has' reads naturally as I've, giving I then VE.
explanation.definitionFit: A bonus paid on top of salary is an example of an incentive, something offered to motivate.

blocks.note: a GI is an American soldier, plus the possessive s
mo is short for moment

explanation.surface: An American soldier has a gadget that needs only a moment.
explanation.definitionFit: A gismo is an informal word for a clever device or gizmo, a synonym of gadget.

blocks.note: first meaning: the act of moving
second meaning: a proposal put to a meeting for a vote

explanation.walkthrough: The 's reads as a possessive but is just 'is', joining the two meanings.
explanation.definitionFit: The word means physical movement and also a proposal tabled in a debate or meeting.

blocks.note: a car is a vehicle
rot means rubbish, nonsense

explanation.surface: Someone scoffs at the idea of being tempted by a car.
explanation.definitionFit: A carrot, as in carrot and stick, is a reward offered to persuade: an inducement.

blocks.note: Cu is the chemical symbol for copper, plus the possessive s
a tom is a male cat

explanation.surface: A police officer's pet cat has its usual routine.
explanation.walkthrough: 'copper' suggests a policeman, but here it is the metal.
explanation.definitionFit: A custom is an established habit or tradition, the usual practice.

indicators.note: outsiders are the outermost letters, and leaving means they are dropped from the word

blocks.note: taken as written

explanation.surface: A queen's bearing once her outside guests have gone.
explanation.walkthrough: Strip the first and last letters from mANNEr. Queen Anne reigned from 1702 to 1714.
explanation.definitionFit: Anne was an English queen, so the name is an example of a queen.

clue.text: Slicer or musical instrument? Guy at party recalled nothing

indicators.note: recalled means called back, so the word is taken in the backward direction

blocks.note: a guy is a man
a do is a party
nil means nothing

explanation.surface: A man at a party remembered nothing, puzzling over a kitchen slicer or an instrument.
explanation.walkthrough: The word names both a lute-like instrument and a kitchen slicer (usually spelt mandoline), so the definition offers both.
explanation.definitionFit: A mandolin is a stringed instrument; the same name is used for a bladed vegetable slicer.

indicators.note: something repaired has been put back together differently, so the letters are rearranged
about means surrounding, so the rearranged furniture word goes round the time letter

blocks.note: taken as written
T is the standard abbreviation for time

explanation.surface: A formidable woman's armchair is finally mended, and not before time.
explanation.walkthrough: '(about time!)' reads as an impatient aside, but it means put the time letter inside.
explanation.definitionFit: A matriarch is a woman who heads a family, a powerful female figure.

clue.text: Unfinished direction about Public Relations growth

indicators.note: unfinished means the end is not there, so the final letter is dropped
about means around, so the shortened word surrounds the other part

blocks.note: south is a compass direction
PR is the abbreviation for public relations

explanation.surface: Incomplete guidance on public relations growth from a PR department.
explanation.walkthrough: 'direction' here is a compass point rather than instructions; it is clipped before it goes round the abbreviation.
explanation.definitionFit: A sprout is a new shoot on a plant, a piece of growth.

indicators.note: wrapped in means enclosed, so the letters sit inside the following words

blocks.note: the letters run across the two words

explanation.surface: A package sold at Spar comes wrapped in cellophane.
explanation.walkthrough: Spar is a chain of convenience stores. The answer is in sPAR CELlophane.
explanation.definitionFit: A parcel is a wrapped bundle sent or carried, a synonym for package.

blocks.note: in means fashionable
a tent is a canvas shelter

explanation.surface: Someone plans a fashionable shelter.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Design' reads as a noun for a plan or drawing; here it means purpose.
explanation.definitionFit: Intent is purpose or aim, which matches design in the sense of 'by design'.

clue.text: Thaw? Opt to change route by river perhaps

indicators.note: to change the letters means to put them in a new arrangement

blocks.note: taken as written
taken as written

explanation.surface: With the ice melting, choose a different route along the river.
explanation.definitionFit: A towpath is a path along a river or canal once used by horses towing barges, a riverside route.

clue.text: Status of turbulent priest — extremely godlike?

indicators.note: turbulent means stirred up and disordered, so the letters are jumbled
extremely points to the extremities of a word, its first and last letters

blocks.note: taken as written
the outside letters of the word

explanation.surface: Asking whether the standing of a troublesome cleric is very godly.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Turbulent priest' recalls Henry II's words about Thomas Becket.
explanation.definitionFit: Prestige is high standing and reputation, a synonym of status.

blocks.note: sh is a call for quiet
a rub is a massage

explanation.surface: A soothing, quiet massage for someone called Hazel.
explanation.walkthrough: Hazel looks like a woman's name, but it is the bush; the question mark marks it as an example.
explanation.definitionFit: Hazel is a small tree or bush, so it is an example of a shrub.

clue.text: Hope wife is home at the outset

indicators.note: the outset is the start, so only the opening letter is wanted

blocks.note: W is the standard abbreviation for wife
taken as written
the first letter of the word

explanation.surface: Someone hopes their wife is home from the start.
explanation.definitionFit: To wish and to hope both mean wanting something to happen; as nouns they are synonyms too.

clue.text: Be a little romantic with server?

blocks.note: first meaning: an old-fashioned verb for kissing and cuddling
second meaning: a utensil for serving food

explanation.walkthrough: The surface suggests flirting with a waiter; 'server' is the kitchen utensil.
explanation.definitionFit: As a verb the word means to behave in a sentimental, amorous way; as a noun it is a serving utensil.

clue.text: Ultimately not mistake to see troublesome child

indicators.note: ultimately means in the end, so only the final letter is kept

blocks.note: the final letter of the word
an error is a mistake

explanation.surface: In the end it was no mistake to meet a difficult child.
explanation.definitionFit: A terror, as in 'little terror', is an informal name for a naughty, troublesome child.

clue.text: What's needed maybe to be mother? To pater, mostly silly

definitions.text: What's needed maybe to be mother?

indicators.note: mostly means most but not all, so the last letter is dropped
silly means foolish or muddled, so the letters are scrambled

blocks.note: taken as written
taken as written

explanation.surface: A mother's role is mocked by a foolish father figure.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Shall I be mother?' is a British phrase meaning 'shall I pour the tea?'. Pater, an old word for father, loses its last letter before the mix.
explanation.definitionFit: Whoever is 'mother' pours the tea, and for that a teapot is needed.

blocks.note: first meaning: fashionable style
second meaning: informal for a great deal

explanation.walkthrough: The style sense comes from French and survives mainly in crosswords and 'bon ton'.
explanation.definitionFit: The word means high fashion or elegance, and informally a great quantity of something.

clue.text: Tardy in supporting round of applause

blocks.note: to be behind someone is to support them
giving someone a hand means clapping them

explanation.surface: Someone was late in backing a round of clapping.
explanation.definitionFit: Behindhand means late or behind schedule, a synonym of tardy.
